design_philosophy: Clean, Clinical, Modern, and Trustworthy. High legibility, role-tailored workflows, zero clutter, structured cards, warm professional aesthetics.

persistent_demo_banner.text: Demo Build — Synthetic Data Only — Not for Clinical Use
persistent_demo_banner.style: bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 text-xs py-1.5 px-4 text-center font-medium tracking-wide flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900
scale.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

dashboard.sidebar: w-full md:w-64 bg-white border-r border-slate-200 p-6 flex flex-col justify-between shrink-0
dashboard.main_content: flex-1 p-6 md:p-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full space-y-8

navigation_and_header.header_rules: Always include persistent logo with icon, 4 navigation links, persistent role indicator/switcher, demo banner top strip, user avatar menu, and language dropdown.
navigation_and_header.backdrop: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-40

component_styling.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-[#0D7377] hover:bg-[#095457] text-white font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-all duration-150 active:scale-[0.99] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0D7377]/20
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg transition-all duration-150
buttons.accent: bg-[#0284C7] hover:bg-[#0369A1] text-white font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-all duration-150

component_styling.inputs: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0D7377] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0D7377]/15 transition-colors
component_styling.tables: w-full border-collapse border border-slate-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden text-sm

general_testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, form inputs, buttons, role cards, tabs, select dropdowns, and status badges MUST carry data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure persistent top banner 'Demo Build — Synthetic Data Only — Not for Clinical Use' is always rendered across all pages.
Support clear role switching (Patient, Doctor, Psychologist, Nutritionist) with distinct dashboard metrics and permissions.
Use Shadcn UI components for dialogs, tabs, date pickers, select dropdowns, toasts (sonner), and tooltips.
Maintain strict healthcare aesthetics: clean white/light slate surfaces, deep teal (#0D7377) primary actions, and clear status badges.
Every page must feel responsive, mobile-optimized, and fully populated with authentic synthetic medical data.
